# Release Notes

## Node Governance & Ratchets
*   **#1903**: Adds the node-home ratchet, refusing new ONEX nodes outside the omnimarket baseline.
*   **#1428**: Implements the canonical handler-shape ratchet-gate, enforcing 3-part adequacy and equivalence.
*   **#1068**: Adds the WORKTREE_GUARD bit to EnumHookBit for git-worktree path enforcement.

## Data Models & Schemas
*   **#1130**: Adds context pack schema models with deterministic chunk_id computation.
*   **#1144**: Introduces Antipattern Registry YAML schema and associated Pydantic models.
*   **#1585**: Declares contract keys for runtime consumption and removes dead metadata reads.
*   **#2902**: Delegation orchestrator declares a typed state_machine for direct loading.

## Security & Verification
*   **#53**: Adds ProtocolPackageVerifier for secure handler distribution and integrity checks.
*   **#1705**: Wires the secrets-baseline census gate to ensure pre-commit and CI consistency.
*   **#341**: Pins the omnibase_core canonical-file-shape hook to the temp-file blob read fix.

## CI/CD & Infrastructure
*   **#1084**: Registers node generation Kafka topics in TopicBase.
*   **#142**: Adds ruff UP007 standards compliance workflow for omnibase_spi.
*   **#1901**: Implements receipt-gate shadow input for repositories refusing non-success check-runs.
*   **#1629**: Stages the zone classifier to fix the md-only short-circuit logic.
*   **#3731**: Hostile Reviewer now reads voters from the contract overlay.
*   **#3132**: Receipt runner waits for a quiet batch window before pushing.
*   **#1719**: Documents and tests the root-anchored merge-sweep pattern.
*   **#1487**: Closes residual sys.modules contaminators missed in previous PRs.
*   **#180**: Bumps softprops/action-gh-release from 2 to 3.
*   **#132**: Bumps actions/checkout from 4 to 6.

## Runtime & Execution
*   **#3821**: Publishes hybrid codegen events previously dropped by the runtime.
*   **#1122**: Adds onex run as a canonical alias for onex node.
*   **#3463**: Adds npm and uv pytest runners for specific repository types.
*   **#3619**: Decides hook refusal ledger rows in a compute node.

## Provider & Routing
*   **#3194**: Adds OpenAI BYOK backend and updates parity gates.
*   **#2913**: Spread-placed backends now share their rung's first-choice traffic.
*   **#3469**: Reports provider availability separately from correctness.

## Observability & Reporting
*   **#3594**: Delegate-skill terminal now stores the tier it was routed to.
*   **#3400**: Parity command prints daily work-ledger parity receipt rows.
*   **#3807**: Decisions exposure serves the cost the store holds in both modes.
